meaning: Superseded native recordings of the ordinary pickup clocks, per configuration, oldest first: each recorded on a clock a later PR changed and recorded again (the current one is in pickup-clock-controls.json). #245 recorded the original 39, #253 all 48 on regenerated clocks, #265 all 48 after the belt window-end trim; later PRs recorded only the clocks they changed. Kept as the in-game evidence of what the earlier clocks did. A capture compares against one PR's recordings with BELT_CLOCK_EXPECTATIONS=<this file>#<pr>.
